En AUTO, c'est un de-esser comme tu les: In AUTO, it's a de-esser as you know it: a THRESHOLD, and everything hissing above it is turned down. Tick what you treat, S, T, CH, F or K, and it touches nothing else: it listens to each sound before treating it to know what it is, so an S stays untouched if you only ticked F. You see what's removed live, sound by sound: the letter shows above each removal. The THRESHOLD line drags right in the view. RANGE caps the reduction, CLARITY brings back the shine of the voice without bringing the S's back, LISTEN lets you hear only what's removed. Recording while singing through the plugin? Tick LIVE: almost no latency, with slightly less precise sorting.
En MANUEL, tu lances simplement ta prise: In MANUAL, you just play your take in your DAW: it records itself, and ONIRIQUE DE-ESSER cuts it up as it goes: every S, every CH, every T and every K, every P and every B, every breath shows up on its own. Hover it, hear it. Drag it down, it goes down, and nothing else moves. No threshold, no compromise: an S that's too loud goes down, the one next to it stays as it is.
Tu ajoutes une piste, tu changes une pri: Added a track, changed a take? It hears it on playback and adds it, without recording again what it already has. Your settings stay in your project. 33 ms of latency, compensated by your DAW (3 ms in LIVE). 10 factory presets, A / B / C, Windows and Mac (VST3 and AU).
